title: ai-agent component diagram
description: The ai-agent crate: one binary in src/, the daemon that downloads and execs it for `zazzle agent llm|prompt` and runs `prompt --no-download` for agents' `--llm`, `brief` and `prompt`, llama.cpp, which it links to run the models, and Hugging Face, from which it downloads them.

components.name: ai-agent
components.responsibility: The package and its binary ai-agent, with the `metal` feature for Apple Silicon.

components.name: ai-agent sources
components.responsibility: The command line, the model catalogue, the model store and its downloads, chat templates, the thinking splitter and the llama.cpp engine.

components.name: daemon
components.responsibility: `zazzle daemon llm ARGS` finds ai-agent beside itself or downloads and verifies it (JIT tools), then execs it with the arguments; the daemon and `zazzle daemon wrap` also run it as a child (`prompt --no-download`, with --grammar and --temp for brief and post-processing).

components.name: llama.cpp (llama-cpp-2)
components.responsibility: Loads GGUF models and decodes tokens on the CPU, or the GPU through Metal on Apple Silicon; compiled into the binary.

components.name: Hugging Face
components.responsibility: Hosts the model files; ai-agent downloads each one over HTTPS at the commit its catalogue pins.

relationships.description: Execs the ai-agent binary beside it or from its tool store, or runs it as a child and reads its answer and exit code (src/llm.rs).
engine.rs loads the model, tokenizes, decodes and samples through llama-cpp-2.
store.rs downloads a model file with ureq, resuming with HTTP Range.
